_comment: Per PLAYBOOK.md step 3 (high-cut-rate recipe), reworked to drop every human-character asset in favor of infographics -- no talking-mouth characters anywhere in this video. Per STYLE_DECODE_v2.md's real-frame decode: maps are real recognizable geography (build_map_paths.py, Natural Earth 110m data) colored by the China-vs-rest-of-world bloc technique, and several assets carry a plain generic stick figure (stickFigure() in render-assets.mjs) for human scale/presence -- deliberately far simpler than the removed talking characters, matching the reference's featureless blob-person. 12 single-file image assets + 6 pure-code (no image) motion graphics, each reused across many shots in shotlist.json with a different overlay/variant rather than regenerated per shot.

assets.description: flat vector official document/form with a letterhead bar and a wax-seal stamp, plus a plain stick figure standing beside it for scale -- replaces the export-official clerk for establishing/idle beats
flat vector blank whiteboard on a stand with a marker tray, plus a plain stick figure standing beside it -- replaces the narrator-analyst figure for the ProgressiveReveal text-build beats
flat vector 3-stage flow diagram: ore rock -> refining flask (highlighted in accent color as the bottleneck, labeled REFINING) -> magnet, connected by arrows

real world landmass geometry (Natural Earth 110m, equirectangular), cream ocean/background, neutral slate-gray countries with China highlighted red -- no labels baked in (labels/pins added as Remotion overlay)
real China mainland silhouette (Natural Earth 110m), solid red fill on cream background, no labels baked in
real contiguous-48 US silhouette (Natural Earth 110m), solid navy fill on cream background, a small red accent dot marking the California region, no labels baked in
flat vector isolated lanthanide row of the periodic table, 17 tiles each with an atomic number and real chemical symbol (Sc, Y, La...Lu)
flat vector stylized sintered permanent magnet icon (simple horseshoe/block shape), single reusable glyph
used_in: every 'this contains rare earths' callout across all chapters

assets.description: flat vector icon set: spoked-ring EV motor, 3-blade wind turbine, donut-bore MRI scanner, delta-wing fighter jet, smartphone, plus a plain stick figure -- five sharpened, unambiguous pictograms to crop from one image
flat vector bird's-eye terraced open-pit mine illustration (concentric rings, mining trucks, a plain stick figure for scale), California desert setting, wide establishing shot
used_in: THE GRUDGE boom/bust/reopen beats (reused 3x with different color grade/era dressing + stat overlay)

assets.description: flat vector industrial chemical-refining plant illustration, tanks, pipes, and scale piping, plus two plain stick figures for human scale -- no named/talking character
flat vector raw ore rock chunk, simple faceted shape with a subtle mixed-mineral color pattern
used_in: THE RECIPE 'digging is the easy part' beat

motion_graphics_no_generation_needed.description: rubber-stamp/signature graphic that stamps down or withholds, built in Remotion (SVG + interpolate) -- the central 'stamp' metaphor payoff. Used at the Opening, end of THE TRAP, and the closing line.
line chart climbing, for the 'prices spiked sixfold' beat in THE CLOCK
countdown/calendar graphic ticking toward Nov 10 2026, for THE CLOCK's ticking-deadline beat
reusable full-bleed navy title-card template with progressive word-by-word reveal, reuse Overlays.tsx / ProgressiveReveal.tsx, one per chapter boundary

full-screen text card, no character -- 'quote' variant (big quotation marks + gold attribution chip) replaces the deng-era-figure quote beat; 'statement' variant (bold centered line) replaces narrator-analyst's direct-address beats. Built in TextCard.tsx.

two-pane message/transcript infographic (labeled speaker cards, active side highlighted) replacing the SplitPhoneCall two-character exchange -- no faces, just labeled text cards. Built in DialogueCards.tsx.
